trap-nonspeakable.notes: VERIFIED AGAINST THE GEOMETRY, with one confirmed error and three confirmations. ERROR: "The Garside element Delta_3 ... form[s] non-torus Reeb-flow trajectories with positive hyperbolic volume ... Its complement is not Seifert-fibered, and its JSJ decomposition contains a hyperbolic piece with a strictly positive Bloch-Wigner sum." Delta_3 = sigma_1 sigma_2 sigma_1. Conjugating by sigma_1 gives sigma_1^2 sigma_2, in which sigma_2 occurs exactly once at the right end, so Markov destabilisation reduces it to sigma_1^2 in B_2 and the closure is the HOPF LINK T(2,2). Its underlying permutation s1 s2 s1 = (1 3) has 2 cycles, confirming 2 components. The Hopf link IS a torus link, IS Seifert-fibered, has volume 0 and a JSJ decomposition with no hyperbolic piece -- which is exactly what the sibling block rem:hopf-link-non-magic states in this same chapter. Every clause quoted above is therefore false for Delta_3. CONFIRMED CORRECT: (a) the Borromean braid is (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^3, whose permutation (s1 s2)^3 is the identity, giving 3 components as required; (b) its volume 8G = 7.3277247534 equals 2 x V_oct with V_oct = 4G = 3.6638623767, so "8G, derived from two regular ideal octahedra" is exactly right; (c) Vol(4_1) = 2 v_3 = 2.0298832128 with v_3 = Cl_2(pi/3) = 1.0149416064 -- the right value under the right name. SECOND ERROR: the Borromean rings complement is NOT "the Gieseking-Meyerhoff manifold". The Gieseking manifold is the non-orientable cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold of volume v_3 = 1.0149, the smallest of all; the Borromean complement has volume 7.3277 and is standardly just called the Borromean rings complement (6^3_2). THIRD NOTE: the block gives the figure-eight braid word as sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1} sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1}, which corroborates the separate finding on prf:hoefsmit-seminormal-form, where the same knot is assigned the commutator sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1} sigma_1^{-1} sigma_2.
